# T-3: Apply policy to lifecycle callers

<!-- Auto-generated by `senti spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Replace caller-specific warning severity inference with structured outcomes in prepare and finalize-cleanup, and prove required failures are atomic at command level.

## Acceptance Criteria
- R7 prepare and finalize-cleanup consume structured outcomes and finalize-cleanup removes its warning scan.
- R6 required failure command tests preserve the enumerated flow-state, issue-log, spec/draft, plugin artifact, transaction, Git ref, worktree, completion-pointer, and active-flow surfaces.
- R8 shared and spec-local tests cover lifecycle matrix and atomicity.

## Implementation Notes
Preserve the existing finalize-cleanup transaction authority. A required failure must return before transaction creation, commit, cleanup, and active-flow completion operations.

## Test Strategy
For prepare, capture bytes for flow state, issue-log, spec/draft, and plugin artifact paths before invoking a required failure, then assert identical bytes and no new files. For finalize-cleanup, capture the base HEAD, feature ref, worktree registration/path, teardown transaction path, completion pointer, and active-flow state; after required failure assert identical HEAD/ref/state, existing worktree/branch, and absent new transaction or pointer. Add spec-local R1-R8 coverage.
